Oil Prices Diverge: ONGC, Oil India Rise Amid Global Crude Surge

Global crude oil prices have seen a surge, leading to an increase in the share prices of ONGC and Oil India. In contrast, state-owned fuel retailers HPCL, BPCL, and IOC experienced a decline in their share values. This comes as neighboring countries like Pakistan and Nepal have reduced their fuel prices, raising questions about why Indian prices remain high.
